title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.71: A card pre-Planned from two sources at once - e.g. Playlist+ (starts Planned) enchanted with Notate (also starts Planned) - now starts combat Planned TWICE (#1 and #2) instead of once. Pre-Planned slots are granted one per source.
